comparison.objective: Candidate recovers finishing media through a screen while retaining washers; pr-1920 installs a full-size click-lock vinyl tile against a laid row.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires bimanual load sharing and tilt/agitation to clear orientation-dependent particle bridges; pr-1920 requires long-edge tongue-and-groove alignment, angled insertion, end-gap positioning, and controlled lowering.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate grades recovered media mass, retained washers, absence of loss/damage, support placement, release, and dwell; pr-1920 grades a locked tile by seam, lippage, end gap, flatness, release, and rest.
comparison.reason: All four specifications were available and describe materially different tested abilities; no comparison-critical rubric detail is missing.
